description: A3 task 8 (F6; #731): the section navigator's access, the workout header, whole timer frames and the pause-aware countdown warning, wired through Round 7's owners on /workout and its open logging dialogs. Navigator (TASK-027): Round 7's compact SectionHeader bar reads position and status to assistive technology with no second heading, and Previous, Next and a jump move focus to the opened section's first card with a temporary tabindex (src/ui/workout-chrome.tsx, src/app/Workout.tsx). Header (TASK-007): one row, the title shrinking and wrapping at 23.75rem and below (src/ui/workout-navigation.css). Clocks (TASK-007): every real-route clock is one whole TimerFrame. Warning (TASK-008): every clock feeds useCountdownUrgency through its per-clock deadline adapter (src/state/countdown-urgency.ts); one shared warning loop, one aura, timer and aura on one breathe and phase (src/ui/countdown-urgency.tsx, .css). check-01 runs the brief's ten files whole and declares every case of the files this task owns whole (countdown-urgency, timer-frame-layout, state/countdown-urgency, workout-chrome, workout-footer-nav, movement-countdown, for-time-block) and the bodies it restores, ports (round-07 R7-2) or adds in the files TASK-110 owns (Workout.test.tsx, emom-block, amrap-block). parity compares each real route this task wires with its accepted gallery state (cards, urgency, emom, amrap, for_time, and the SectionHeader specimen) at 320 and 390. Every declared case must execute and pass.
